Particle data can be sourced into the gas simulation from a separate emitter. This module initializes the controls and rasterization grids for that process.
There are two rasterization grid types available: The deterministic Rasterization Grid and the faster Grid 3D Collection. 
This module works with two other modules to perform the reading, rasterization and application of the particle data:
Grid3D_Gas_SplatParticleDataIntoRasterGrid requires it's own stage and fills the rasterization grids from the particle data.
Grid3D_Gas_GetParticleDataFromRasterGrid fetches the data from the relevant structure ready for sourcing into the simulation.
The above modules get all the information they need from Emitter parameters created by this module. All the controls reside here.
